description:
Freeware PCB design and engineering calculator suite

The Saturn PCB Toolkit is a freeware suite of calculators for PCB design and engineering. It includes tools for microstrip and stripline impedance, differential pairs, via current, conductor current, planar inductors, padstacks, crosstalk, Ohm's Law, and more, following industry specifications such as IPC-2152.
